title: Ezra — Instructions and Commands
content:
Ezra — Instructions and Commands

Instructions · All Old Testament books · Original Torah and New Testament index

24 additional passage records · 32 quoted verse units. Read Ezra in Saints Translation.

This is a working instruction register organized by topic and then classification. Open a passage for its exact wording, source link and context note. Historical orders and rhetorical or poetic addresses retain their original setting; their presence here does not make them universal laws.

Review status: Working catalogue: the source collection covers every Old Testament book currently in Saints.Bible. Individual commands, repeated formulations, speakers and Christian application still require further review; this is not a certified exhaustive count of laws.

Topics: Faith, repentance and allegiance · Worship, prayer and holy things · Justice, truth and protection · Family, marriage and household · Wisdom, speech and conduct · Work, possessions and stewardship · Historical commissions, journeys and public life

Faith, repentance and allegiance

Historical · 3 passage records

Ezra 1:2 – Ezra 1:3

Record type: Historical direction. Source section: The Proclamation of Cyrus.

Ezra 1:2 — “Thus says Cyrus king of the Persians: The Lord, God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth, and He has charged me to build Him a house in Jerusalem in Judea.

Ezra 1:3 — Who among you belongs to any of His people? His God will be with him, and he will go up to Jerusalem in Judea. Let him build the house of the God of Israel—He is the God in Jerusalem.

Context and scope: A direction recorded in this narrative. Its original speaker, recipient and occasion must be retained; recording an order does not establish that God approves it or commands every believer to repeat it.

Ezra 6:7 – Ezra 6:8

Record type: Historical direction. Source section: Darius Orders Support for the Work.

Ezra 6:7 — leave the work on God’s house alone. Let the leaders of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build that house of God on its site.

Ezra 6:8 — I have issued a decision that you must not do anything with the elders of the Jews concerning the building of that house of God. From the king’s resources, from the taxes beyond the river, let the expense be diligently supplied to those men, so that it is not stopped.

Record type: Historical direction. Source section: Darius Orders Support for the Work.

Ezra 6:12 — The God whose name dwells there will overthrow every king and people who stretches out a hand to alter or destroy that house of God in Jerusalem. I, Darius, have issued the decision; it shall be carried out diligently.”
